mechanism: Third-generation cephalosporins like cefepime can inhibit vitamin K-dependent clotting factor synthesis and increase hypoprothrombinemia risk, particularly in patients with compromised nutritional status or prolonged antibiotic use.
action: Monitor INR/PT in patients on concurrent therapy, especially those with risk factors for hypoprothrombinemia; consider vitamin K supplementation if antibiotic course is prolonged (>7-10 days).
